name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo Mendoza's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly after a career in law enforcement in Mexico City. Frustrated with the bureaucracy, he sought a more dynamic environment where his skills in risk assessment and crisis management could be applied directly. He joined a small racing team as a security consultant, quickly proving his worth by implementing robust safety protocols that minimized incidents and protected valuable assets. 

His experience in high-pressure situations and his meticulous approach to detail have earned him a reputation as a highly reliable security chief. Ricardo believes in a proactive security strategy, focusing on prevention through careful planning and rigorous training. He's known for his ability to anticipate potential threats and implement effective countermeasures, ensuring the safety and security of the team, its personnel, and equipment.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with a serious demeanor and a commanding presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting observations.
Insists on a thorough perimeter check before any major event, regardless of existing security measures.
Has a habit of chewing on a toothpick when deep in thought.
